desc:
🌊 DON'T SPLASH. IT HEARS THE WATER. 🌊
Something blind lives in the flooded Poolrooms. One splash... and it comes for you.

🎃 HALLOWEEN: finish any chapter by Nov 1 to get the limited badge!
👹 NEW: become the monster and hunt your friends!
👥 Play with up to 3 friends, or tap "Shift with others".

📜 RULES OF THE NIGHT SHIFT
1. Don't splash.
2. Stay in the light.
3. When the whistle blows, don't move.
4. Never look away from the staff.
5. If it comes for you, hide in a black locker.
6. Don't scream. It hears your voice too.

🚪 10 CHAPTERS: the Poolrooms • the White Rooms • the stone hands • the yellow Backrooms • the Lifeguard • the Ducks • the faceless Staff • the Flood...

💻 PC: Shift run • C crouch • E interact • H hint
🎧 Headphones recommended. Jumpscares!
👍 LIKE + ⭐ FAVORITE for new chapters!
